titulo.alumno: The imperfetto and duration

descripcion: Form the imperfetto, combine it with passato prossimo and trapassato, and express duration that is still going on.

titulo.alumno: Pronouns

descripcion: Use direct and indirect pronouns, combine them with modal verbs and make them agree in compound tenses.

titulo.alumno: Comparisons and exclamations

descripcion: Compare and express degrees, superlatives, sameness and quantity with common indefinite words.

titulo.alumno: Plans, dates and invitations

descripcion: Talk about plans with the present and future, express guesses and recognise irregular stems.

titulo.alumno: The body, advice and the pharmacy

descripcion: Understand advice and instructions with imperatives for tu, noi, voi and Lei.

titulo.alumno: Work, places and rules

descripcion: Read rules and services; use the gerund, progressive periphrases and time markers.

titulo.alumno: Travel: booking, counting and liking

descripcion: Read travel and housing notices, express duration and use prepositions of time and place.

titulo.alumno: The weather, conditions and opinions

descripcion: Add nuance with adverbs, già/ancora/appena, and follow real conditions in short texts.

titulo.estudio: Mi ha detto che è stanco
titulo.alumno: Reporting what someone said, relative clauses, «prima di» and final review

descripcion: Bring together connectors, references and real conditions in a final A2 reading.

titulo.alumno: What had happened

descripcion: Put earlier actions, background and completed events in order with trapassato, imperfetto, passato prossimo and futuro.

titulo.alumno: The conditional: wishes, advice and what would have happened

descripcion: Form the present and past conditional, use politeness and advice, and recognise auxiliaries in compound tenses.

titulo.alumno: The present congiuntivo

descripcion: Practise forms and uses of the congiuntivo with opinion, wish and necessity; distinguish certainty and choose between the infinitive and «che».

titulo.alumno: The «if» clauses of reality and unreality

descripcion: Contrast real and hypothetical conditions and follow the relationship between condition and result.

titulo.estudio: Mi ha detto che era stanco
titulo.alumno: Reporting what someone else said

descripcion: Interpret changes of tense and person in reported speech, questions and reported orders.

titulo.estudio: Il posto più bello del mondo
titulo.alumno: Comparing, relative clauses and who or what

descripcion: Compare precisely and recognise che, cui and dove according to the function of the relative pronoun.

titulo.alumno: Combined pronouns and particles

descripcion: Combine pronouns and understand what ci and ne refer to, and agreement in compound tenses.

titulo.alumno: The gerund and impersonal constructions

descripcion: Form gerunds, use stare + gerund and its pronouns; distinguish impersonal si and passive si, with agreement.

titulo.alumno: Causes, contrasts, time and text organisation

descripcion: Follow relationships of cause, purpose, concession, contrast and consequence through connectors.

titulo.alumno: Work, formal messages and practical reading

descripcion: Read stories, news, notices and procedures; infer vocabulary and review B1 structures.

titulo.alumno: The passive form and impersonal verbs

descripcion: Recognise passives in compound tenses, nuances of venire/andare and agreement with passive si and modals.

titulo.alumno: The remote past for telling a story

descripcion: Read regular and irregular passato remoto in biographies and narratives, paying attention to register and sequence.

titulo.alumno: Infinitive and gerund: earlier action, cause and manner

descripcion: Interpret earlier action, cause and manner with the infinitive and the gerund, and tell which action is left out with senza.

titulo.alumno: Congiuntivo passato and trapassato, and sequence of tenses

descripcion: Connect the main and subordinate tenses, including relative clauses with a specific or non-specific antecedent.

titulo.alumno: The ipotetici periods of possibility, past unreality and mixed

descripcion: Interpret past and mixed unreal conditions and comparisons with come se.

titulo.alumno: Relative pronouns, indefinites and references

descripcion: Interpret il cui and relatives without an explicit antecedent according to gender, number and function.

titulo.alumno: Concession, result, purpose, time and exception

descripcion: Follow concession, purpose, time and exception with the subjunctive and complex connectors.

titulo.alumno: Pronominal verbs, indefinites and adverbs in -mente

descripcion: Recognise pronominal verbs, nominalisations and nuances of evaluation in texts.

titulo.alumno: React, ask questions and read B2 texts

descripcion: Analyse news, opinions and instructions, contrasting claims, evidence, reservations and conditions.

titulo.alumno: Formal register, future perfect and complex reported speech

descripcion: Read contracts, bank notices, stories and guides; interpret register, future perfect and reported speech.
